data.observations: Exact baseline: sentinel PASS and both adapters ACCEPT. A same-name d12 proposition change from True to True -> True with an identity-lambda proof was accepted by both checkers; the sentinel reported statement differs for PipelineCompleteness.d12. A d12 name change to d12_substituted with its original True proposition/proof was accepted by both; the sentinel reported intended root target absent. Thus both artifacts were well-typed yet different from the requested object, and the independent identity check detected both.
data.limitations: Finite retained twelve-theorem chain, one changed-proposition and one changed-name construction, two bound adapters. Checker acceptance verifies each supplied well-typed artifact, not that it is the requested object. The sentinel uses a broad FAIL_PARSE_OR_DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE code for the changed proposition; its reason field identifies the statement mismatch. No broader completeness or kernel soundness claim follows.
data.decision: NO_SIGNAL for missed target substitution by the combined checker-plus-sentinel route in this declared sample. Retain both well-typed fixtures as checking-completeness controls; checker acceptance alone remains insufficient as an intended-object receipt. No separate confirmation is compelled by these expected observations.
data.cost: 6 supervised checker launches; no execution retry; summed supervised checker elapsed 0.313058 s; all 6 had positive RSS samples and cleanup complete. Model token/cost attribution is deferred to campaign handoff.
